$comment: GPU allowlist read by src/server/gpu-allowlist.ts. Rules are tried in order; the first match wins; otherwise the backend's fallback applies. status: allowed (benched against the live thresholds and passed) | untested (registers, gets no jobs while GPU_ALLOWLIST_MODE=enforce) | blocked (registration refused while GPU_ALLOWLIST_MODE=enforce). name = case-insensitive regular expression tried on the reported GPU name and the Vulkan deviceName. computeCap = when the node reports a compute capability it must be one of these. How to add a family: docs/gpu-support.md.
